source: Google Search Console, Pages export, filtered to /ram/ and /ssd/ product URLs
note: PRE-DEMOTION WINDOW ON PURPOSE. Impressions collapsed 96% on 2026-08-23, so any later window measures the penalty rather than the demand this page once had. Keys are '<category>/<slug>', the same form GSC_CRAWLED_NOT_INDEXED uses; derive one from an exported URL with new URL(u).pathname.replace(/^\//,'').replace(/\/$/,''). Merged as a LEFT JOIN onto the catalog: a slug absent here reads 0 impressions and is never dropped, and a slug here that matches no page is reported by --index-plan rather than failing the build. The gate is ADMIT-ONLY: it can rescue a page that passes no fact gate, and can never evict one that does.
